verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּֽי־ תָב֣וֹא אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָ֑ה וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֖הּ וְיָשַׁ֥בְתָּ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- ṯā·ḇō·w ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā na·ḥă·lāh wî·riš·tāh wə·yā·šaḇ·tā bāh
verses.literal: When you enter . . . the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance and you take possession of it and settle in it
verses.literalPt: E SERÁ que, quando entrares na terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te der por herança, e a possuíres, e nela habitares,

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ מֵרֵאשִׁ֣ית׀ כָּל־ פְּרִ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר תָּבִ֧יא מֵֽאַרְצְךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָ֖ךְ וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ בַטֶּ֑נֶא וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֙ אֶל־ הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā mê·rê·šîṯ kāl- pə·rî hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer tā·ḇî mê·’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ wə·śam·tā ḇaṭ·ṭe·ne wə·hā·laḵ·tā ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·šak·kên šə·mōw šām
verses.literal: you are to take some of the firstfruits of all your produce - from the soil of the land that the LORD your God is giving you and put them in a basket Then go to the place the LORD your God will choose . . . as a dwelling for His Name
verses.literalPt: Então tomarás das primícias de todos os frutos do solo, que recolheres da terra, que te dá o SENHOR teu Deus, e as porás num cesto, e irás ao lugar que escolher o SENHOR teu Deus, para ali fazer habitar o seu nome.

verses.original: וּבָאתָ֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֑ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו הִגַּ֤דְתִּי הַיּוֹם֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כִּי־ בָ֙אתִי֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ לָ֥תֶת לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·ṯā ’el- hak·kō·hên ’ă·šer yih·yeh bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw hig·gaḏ·tî hay·yō·wm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā kî- ḇā·ṯî ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū lā·ṯeṯ lā·nū
verses.literal: to the priest who is serving at that time and say to him I declare today to the LORD your God that I have entered . . . the land that the LORD swore to our fathers to give us
verses.literalPt: E irás ao sacerdote, que houver naqueles dias, e dir-lhe-ás: Hoje declaro perante o SENHOR teu Deus que entrei na terra que o SENHOR jurou a nossos pais dar-nos.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַטֶּ֖נֶא מִיָּדֶ֑ךָ וְהִ֨נִּיח֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֕י מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên haṭ·ṭe·ne mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·hin·nî·ḥōw lip̄·nê miz·baḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hands and place it before the altar of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote tomará o cesto da tua mão, e o porá diante do altar do SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: וְעָנִ֨יתָ וְאָמַרְתָּ֜ לִפְנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֲרַמִּי֙ אֹבֵ֣ד אָבִ֔י וַיֵּ֣רֶד מִצְרַ֔יְמָה וַיָּ֥גָר שָׁ֖ם בִּמְתֵ֣י מְעָ֑ט וַֽיְהִי־ שָׁ֕ם לְג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל עָצ֥וּם וָרָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·nî·ṯā wə·’ā·mar·tā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·ram·mî ’ō·ḇêḏ ’ā·ḇî way·yê·reḏ miṣ·ray·māh way·yā·ḡār šām bim·ṯê mə·‘āṭ way·hî- šām lə·ḡō·w gā·ḏō·wl ‘ā·ṣūm wā·rāḇ
verses.literal: and you are to declare . . . before the LORD your God My father was a wandering Aramean and he went down to Egypt few in number and lived there . . . and became a great nation mighty and numerous
verses.literalPt: Então testificarás perante o SENHOR teu Deus, e dirás: Arameu, prestes a perecer, foi meu pai, e desceu ao Egito, e ali peregrinou com pouca gente, porém ali cresceu até vir a ser nação grande, poderosa, e numerosa.

verses.original: וַיָּרֵ֧עוּ אֹתָ֛נוּ הַמִּצְרִ֖ים וַיְעַנּ֑וּנוּ וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ עָלֵ֖ינוּ עֲבֹדָ֥ה קָשָֽׁה׃
verses.literal: But the Egyptians mistreated us and afflicted us putting us . . . to hard labor
verses.literalPt: Mas os egípcios nos maltrataram e nos afligiram, e sobre nós impuseram uma dura servidão.

verses.original: וַנִּצְעַ֕ק אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ קֹלֵ֔נוּ וַיַּ֧רְא אֶת־ עָנְיֵ֛נוּ וְאֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֖נוּ וְאֶת־ לַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·niṣ·‘aq ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū way·yiš·ma‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- qō·lê·nū way·yar ’eṯ- ‘ā·nə·yê·nū wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lê·nū wə·’eṯ- la·ḥă·ṣê·nū
verses.literal: So we called out to the LORD the God of our fathers and the LORD heard our voice and saw our affliction toil and oppression
verses.literalPt: Então clamamos ao SENHOR Deus de nossos pais; e o SENHOR ouviu a nossa voz, e atentou para a nossa miséria, e para o nosso trabalho, e para a nossa opressão.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִאֵ֤נוּ יְהוָה֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם בְּיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבִזְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמֹרָ֖א גָּדֹ֑ל וּבְאֹת֖וֹת וּבְמֹפְתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣi·’ê·nū Yah·weh mim·miṣ·ra·yim bə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh ū·ḇiz·rō·a‘ nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇə·mō·rā gā·ḏōl ū·ḇə·’ō·ṯō·wṯ ū·ḇə·mō·p̄ə·ṯîm
verses.literal: Then the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm with great terror signs and wonders
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR nos tirou do Egito com mão forte, e com braço estendido, e com grande espanto, e com sinais, e com milagres;

verses.original: וַיְבִאֵ֖נוּ אֶל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַיִּתֶּן־ לָ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇi·’ê·nū ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh way·yit·ten- lā·nū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: And He brought us to this place and gave us this land a land flowing with milk and honey
verses.literalPt: E nos trouxe a este lugar, e nos deu esta terra, terra que mana leite e mel.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּ֤ה הֵבֵ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ רֵאשִׁית֙ פְּרִ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תָּה לִּ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְהִנַּחְתּ֗וֹ לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֔יתָ לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh hê·ḇê·ṯî ’eṯ- rê·šîṯ pə·rî hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tāh lî Yah·weh wə·hin·naḥ·tōw lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wî·ṯā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: And now behold I have brought the firstfruits of the land that You, O LORD have given me Then you are to place the basket before the LORD your God and bow down before Him . . .
verses.literalPt: E eis que agora eu trouxe as primícias dos frutos da terra que tu, ó SENHOR, me deste. Então as porás perante o SENHOR teu Deus, e te inclinarás perante o SENHOR teu Deus,

verses.original: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֣ בְכָל־ הַטּ֗וֹב אֲשֶׁ֧ר נָֽתַן־ לְךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּלְבֵיתֶ֑ךָ אַתָּה֙ וְהַלֵּוִ֔י וְהַגֵּ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·maḥ·tā ḇə·ḵāl- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ ’ă·šer nā·ṯan- lə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ū·lə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā ’at·tāh wə·hal·lê·wî wə·hag·gêr ’ă·šer bə·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: So you shall rejoice you the Levite and the foreigner dwelling among you in all the good things the LORD your God has given to you and your household
verses.literalPt: E te alegrarás por todo o bem que o SENHOR teu Deus te tem dado a ti e à tua casa, tu e o levita, e o estrangeiro que está no meio de ti.

verses.original: כִּ֣י תְכַלֶּ֞ה לַ֠עְשֵׂר אֶת־ כָּל־ מַעְשַׂ֧ר תְּבוּאָתְךָ֛ בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖ת שְׁנַ֣ת הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֑ר וְנָתַתָּ֣ה לַלֵּוִ֗י לַגֵּר֙ לַיָּת֣וֹם וְלָֽאַלְמָנָ֔ה וְאָכְל֥וּ בִשְׁעָרֶ֖יךָ וְשָׂבֵֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯə·ḵal·leh la‘·śêr ’eṯ- kāl- ma‘·śar tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯə·ḵā baš·šā·nāh haš·šə·lî·šiṯ šə·naṯ ham·ma·‘ă·śêr wə·nā·ṯat·tāh lal·lê·wî lag·gêr lay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·lā·’al·mā·nāh wə·’ā·ḵə·lū ḇiš·‘ā·re·ḵā wə·śā·ḇê·‘ū
verses.literal: When you have finished laying aside . . . a tenth of all your produce in the third year the year of the tithe you are to give it to the Levite the foreigner the fatherless and the widow that they may eat and be filled within your gates
verses.literalPt: Quando acabares de separar todos os dízimos da tua colheita no ano terceiro, que é o ano dos dízimos, então os darás ao levita, ao estrangeiro, ao órfão e à viúva, para que comam dentro das tuas portas, e se fartem;

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ לִפְנֵי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בִּעַ֧רְתִּי הַקֹּ֣דֶשׁ מִן־ הַבַּ֗יִת וְגַ֨ם נְתַתִּ֤יו לַלֵּוִי֙ וְלַגֵּר֙ לַיָּת֣וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֔ה כְּכָל־ מִצְוָתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתָ֑נִי לֹֽא־ עָבַ֥רְתִּי מִמִּצְוֺתֶ֖יךָ וְלֹ֥א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bi·‘ar·tî haq·qō·ḏeš min- hab·ba·yiṯ wə·ḡam nə·ṯat·tîw lal·lê·wî wə·lag·gêr lay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·lā·’al·mā·nāh kə·ḵāl- miṣ·wā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯā·nî lō- ‘ā·ḇar·tî mim·miṣ·wō·ṯe·ḵā wə·lō šā·ḵā·ḥə·tî
verses.literal: Then you shall declare in the presence of the LORD your God I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite the foreigner the fatherless and the widow according to all the commandments You have given me I have not transgressed or forgotten Your commandments . . .
verses.literalPt: E dirás perante o SENHOR teu Deus: Tirei da minha casa as coisas consagradas e as dei também ao levita, e ao estrangeiro, e ao órfão e à viúva, conforme a todos os teus mandamentos que me tens ordenado; não transgredi os teus mandamentos, nem deles me esqueci;

verses.original: לֹא־ אָכַ֨לְתִּי בְאֹנִ֜י מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וְלֹא־ בִעַ֤רְתִּי מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ בְּטָמֵ֔א וְלֹא־ נָתַ֥תִּי מִמֶּ֖נּוּ לְמֵ֑ת שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י עָשִׂ֕יתִי כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ’ā·ḵal·tî ḇə·’ō·nî mim·men·nū wə·lō- ḇi·‘ar·tî mim·men·nū bə·ṭā·mê wə·lō- nā·ṯat·tî mim·men·nū lə·mêṯ šā·ma‘·tî bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy ‘ā·śî·ṯî kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯā·nî
verses.literal: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion . . . while in mourning or removed any of it while unclean . . . or offered any of it for the dead I have obeyed . . . the LORD my God I have done everything You commanded me
verses.literalPt: Delas não comi no meu luto, nem delas nada tirei quando imundo, nem delas dei para os mortos; obedeci à voz do SENHOR meu Deus; conforme a tudo o que me ordenaste, tenho feito.

verses.original: הַשְׁקִיפָה֩ מִמְּע֨וֹן קָדְשְׁךָ֜ מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וּבָרֵ֤ךְ אֶֽת־ עַמְּךָ֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֵת֙ הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּה לָ֑נוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּ֙עְתָּ֙ לַאֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: haš·qî·p̄āh mim·mə·‘ō·wn qāḏ·šə·ḵā min- haš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’êṯ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tāh lā·nū ka·’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tā la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: Look down from Your holy habitation from heaven and bless Your people Israel and the land You have given us as You swore to our fathers a land flowing with milk and honey
verses.literalPt: Olha desde a tua santa habitação, desde o céu, e abençoa o teu povo, a Israel, e a terra que nos deste, como juraste a nossos pais, terra que mana leite e mel.

verses.original: הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ מְצַוְּךָ֧ לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת אֶת־ הַחֻקִּ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֤ וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ אוֹתָ֔ם בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·wm haz·zeh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- ha·ḥuq·qîm hā·’êl·leh wə·’eṯ- ham·miš·pā·ṭîm wə·šā·mar·tā wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’ō·w·ṯām bə·ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD your God commands you this day to follow these statutes and ordinances You must be careful to follow them with all your heart and with all your soul
verses.literalPt: Neste dia, o SENHOR teu Deus te manda cumprir estes estatutos e juízos; guarda-os pois, e cumpre-os com todo o teu coração e com toda a tua alma.

verses.original: אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה הֶאֱמַ֖רְתָּ הַיּ֑וֹם לִהְיוֹת֩ לְךָ֨ לֵֽאלֹהִ֜ים וְלָלֶ֣כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֗יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֨ר חֻקָּ֧יו וּמִצְוֺתָ֛יו וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֥עַ בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- Yah·weh he·’ĕ·mar·tā hay·yō·wm lih·yō·wṯ lə·ḵā lê·lō·hîm wə·lā·le·ḵeṯ biḏ·rā·ḵāw wə·liš·mōr ḥuq·qāw ū·miṣ·wō·ṯāw ū·miš·pā·ṭāw wə·liš·mō·a‘ bə·qō·lōw
verses.literal: Today you have proclaimed that the LORD is your God and that you will walk in His ways keep His statutes and commandments and ordinances and listen to His voice
verses.literalPt: Hoje declaraste ao SENHOR que ele te será por Deus, e que andarás nos seus caminhos, e guardarás os seus estatutos, e os seus mandamentos, e os seus juízos, e darás ouvidos à sua voz.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֞ה הֶאֱמִֽירְךָ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם לִהְי֥וֹת לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ לָ֑ךְ וְלִשְׁמֹ֖ר כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh he·’ĕ·mî·rə·ḵā hay·yō·wm lih·yō·wṯ lōw lə·‘am sə·ḡul·lāh ka·’ă·šer dib·ber- lāḵ wə·liš·mōr kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯāw
verses.literal: And today the LORD has proclaimed that you are His people and treasured possession as He promised that you are to keep all His commandments
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR hoje te declarou que tu lhe serás por seu próprio povo, como te tem dito, e que guardarás todos os seus mandamentos.

verses.original: וּֽלְתִתְּךָ֣ עֶלְי֗וֹן עַ֤ל כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה לִתְהִלָּ֖ה וּלְשֵׁ֣ם וּלְתִפְאָ֑רֶת וְלִֽהְיֹתְךָ֧ עַם־ קָדֹ֛שׁ לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ṯit·tə·ḵā ‘el·yō·wn ‘al kāl- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh liṯ·hil·lāh ū·lə·šêm ū·lə·ṯip̄·’ā·reṯ wə·lih·yō·ṯə·ḵā ‘am- qā·ḏōš Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ka·’ă·šer dib·bêr
verses.literal: that He will set you high in praise and name and honor above all the nations He has made and that you will be a holy people to the LORD your God as He has promised
verses.literalPt: Para assim te exaltar sobre todas as nações que criou, para louvor, e para fama, e para glória, e para que sejas um povo santo ao SENHOR teu Deus, como tem falado.
